entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I... I need some help. I have an order, I think. It's for a jersey, but I'm just so confused by the website.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have an order number I can look up for you?
Oh, yes, I think so. Let me see... It's VF77301. I hope that's right. All these numbers are so overwhelming.

No problem at all. Let me just pull that up... Okay, I see the order for one ProFit Jersey, delivered about 77 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference matter?

I... I guess it's a preference? I ordered the wrong size. I finally got around to trying it on for a ride and it's just way too tight. I really wanted to do an exchange, but the return page had so many options. Can't you just help me?
Of course. I can absolutely help you with that. Let me just double-check our policy for you. One moment.
Okay, thank you. I was worried it was too late.

Alright, I've confirmed it. Your jersey is a standard apparel item, which falls under our 90-day return policy. Since you received it 77 days ago, you're still well within the timeframe for a return or an exchange.
Oh, really? That's a huge relief! I was so sure I had missed the window. Thank you so much!

You're very welcome. I'm processing the return authorization now. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label. You can just print that out, put the jersey back in its original packaging, and drop it at any post office. Would you prefer a refund or an exchange for a different size?
An exchange would be perfect! I'd love to get the right size. Thank you, Charlie, you've made this so easy.
Happy to help. The email is on its way. Once we receive the original jersey, we'll ship out the new size to you immediately. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been wonderful. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
